title: From a Single Mini Mill to 5-Axis Precision: How TitanTech CNC Is Growing With Xometry
summary: Joining the Xometry Partner Network helped Arizona-based TitanTech CNC transform from a one-machine startup into a multi-axis precision shop without sacrificing hands-on quality or on-time delivery.
body_markdown:
For a newly established, owner-operated shop, breaking into complex production work usually requires connections or years of relationship building. Partnering with Xometry gave Flores an immediate avenue to win work and demonstrate his technical skills.


"It gave me a way to compete for real production work while I was still building the company, and the relationship quickly became an important part of TitanTech CNC's growth," Flores said. To date, TitanTech has completed more than 400 Xometry jobs, generating almost $800,000 in revenue.


“What I value most is the access to a wide variety of manufacturing work and the opportunity it gives a small shop to prove itself through performance,” Flores said. “Xometry has allowed me to take on projects across different materials, geometries, tolerances, and levels of complexity. That steady exposure to new work has helped me grow both as a machinist and as a business owner.”


Rather than adding overhead, Flores channeled the revenue and momentum from Xometry jobs directly back into the shop floor. He sold his original Mini Mill and upgraded to a robust three-machine lineup: a Haas VF-2SS vertical machining center, a Haas TL-1P CNC lathe, and a Haas UMC-500SS 5-axis machining center. Alongside new machinery, he invested in in-house laser engraving for identification and logos, as well as upgraded CAM software, probing, workholding, and inspection tools.


“Those investments allow me to quote and successfully produce parts today that I would not have been equipped to take on when I first joined the platform,” Flores said.
